shared_context.chief_complaint: Accidental traumatic amputation of the right index finger in shop class
shared_context.vitals: Temperature 98.0°F (36.6°C), blood pressure 120/70 mmHg, pulse 105/min, respirations 17/min
shared_context.exam_findings: Pulsatile bleeding from a clean-cut wound on the right second finger
shared_context.imaging: Hand radiography revealed complete amputation of the right finger from the distal interphalangeal joint
shared_context.correct_answer: Rinse the finger in normal saline, wrap the finger in moist gauze, put in a plastic bag, and place the bag in ice water (A)
